items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Willie Foster was playing Brody in his band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Harrison Bond.

ctx.x: Yeah. Willie Foster was playing Brody in his band. You have a trombone? Yeah. And Harrison Bond.

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I had to call him on piano... He was on piano, and Willie Foster was on drums.

ctx.x: Drew Howard, Paul. Myself. What was Paul playing?
I had to call him on piano. Oh, how do you call that? Paul. I can't call his name, no. He was on piano, and Willie Foster was on drums. He was on the violin.
We had a good band in there.
